g.text: Annual turnover comes from fully paid invoices
in the calendar year ending on 31 December.
Unpaid invoices do not contribute to turnover.
Store this rate for the next calendar year (AD28).
Store calendarYear = nextYear and percentage = computed rate
Reject new orders until the full outstanding balance is paid.

this flag does NOT mean the order discount was consumed.
